product.title: Analytics Lab
product.summary: Build a weighted metric, test it against the data, and write the scouting report.
product.whatStudentsDo: Students pick a sport, explore a full statistical dataset, build a custom weighted metric with live sliders, examine percentiles, scatter plots and correlations, run what-if changes, then write and export a scouting report defending the metric they built.
product.technology: Alpine.js static site with charting and PDF export

studentDataProfile.notes: Student name is captured client-side and embedded in a share link and an exported PDF filename. No server storage observed.

governance.maturityBasis: The most sophisticated data-literacy build in the account, reachable and producing an exportable artefact. No student-run evidence exists.

health.technicalBasis: Playtested end to end 2026-08-16. The weighting tool itself works and the leaderboard genuinely reorders — a scoring-first weighting put Embiid first at 81, a defence-first weighting put Gilgeous-Alexander first at 66 — but the charting throughout is dead and the console fills with errors.
knownBlockers: Selecting any sport fires 24 repeated page errors (Cannot read properties of null, reading id / ppg / reb), every time.
Every chart renders an empty plot area with axis labels and no bars, in both Build Stat and the Report.
Write My Report throws Maximum call stack size exceeded.
QR export is blocked and does not load.
On a phone the stats table shows 3 of 8 columns with no scroll affordance, and the tab bar loses its labels.

curation.tierBasis: The weighting tool works and the leaderboard genuinely reorders, but every chart renders empty, the report throws, and selecting a sport fires 24 errors.

provenance.evidence: BSC-BUILDANALYTIC/index.html describes the Track 201 lane as 'Full dataset · percentile scores · scatter & stacked charts · What-If simulator · share & export' for 'Grades 7–8'.
